# Approved identity addresses for the physical Git object audit.
#
# Each entry is a public, intentionally-published authoring identity for this
# fleet — never a leaked personal address. The audit fails closed on any
# address absent from this file, so adding an address here is an explicit
# maintainer decision that it is public and safe to ship in metadata.
#
# The maintainer's public authoring address (stefan@preu.at) is an intentional
# public identity used across the unbraind/pm-* fleet; it is approved here as a
# deliberate public authoring identity, not as a blanket allowlist of personal
# addresses. A different work address (a previously purged work address) was purged from history
# in 2026-07 and must never be re-added.
# The maintainer's GitHub noreply address.
1153461+unbraind@users.noreply.github.com
# GitHub's committer for merges made through the web UI.
noreply@github.com
# The maintainer's intentional public authoring identity for the unbraind fleet.
stefan@preu.at

# The GitHub Actions bot, which authors the release commit created by
# .github/workflows/release.yml. It must be listed here: the first release would
# otherwise write a commit that this very audit rejects on every subsequent run,
# leaving the gate permanently red. Found on unbraind/pm-rust#6 and applied here.
41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com

# Dependabot authors every dependency-bump commit on this repository. The audit
# inspects every physical Git object -- including the unreachable commit objects
# a Dependabot pull request introduces into a CI checkout's object database -- so
# an unlisted Dependabot identity fails the gate on every Dependabot PR. The
# address is exact (no wildcard): a different user-id prefix or a human address
# is still rejected, so this approves only genuine Dependabot commits.
49699333+dependabot[bot]@users.noreply.github.com
